readings: Join scans to sites on scans.zoneref = sites.zoneregistry and drop unmatched scans. Group by sites.healtheval. For each status, compute the rate as the mean of the per-scan ratio gbsize/spanmin, using only scans where both values are non-null and spanmin is not 0. Also count, for each status, the matched scans that have a valid rate. Take the unweighted mean of the status rates as the all-status average. If it is null, return no statuses. Keep the statuses whose rate is strictly above that average. In one unrounded row, return (a) the mean of those statuses' rates, (b) the mean of those statuses' valid-rate scan counts, and (c) the mean of (status rate minus the all-status average) across those statuses.

Join scans to sites on scans.zoneref = sites.zoneregistry and drop unmatched scans. Group by sites.healtheval. For each status, compute the rate as the mean of the per-scan ratio gbsize/spanmin, using only scans where both values are non-null and spanmin is not 0. Also count, for each status, all matched scans, including those with a missing or invalid rate. Take the unweighted mean of the status rates as the all-status average. If it is null, return no statuses. Keep the statuses whose rate is strictly above that average. In one unrounded row, return (a) the mean of those statuses' rates, (b) the mean of those statuses' total matched-scan counts, and (c) the mean of (status rate minus the all-status average) across those statuses.
queries:
WITH scan_rates AS (
  SELECT s.healtheval AS status,
         sc.gbsize * 1.0 / sc.spanmin AS ratio
  FROM scans sc
  JOIN sites s ON sc.zoneref = s.zoneregistry
  WHERE sc.gbsize IS NOT NULL AND sc.spanmin IS NOT NULL AND sc.spanmin <> 0
),
status_stats AS (
  SELECT status, AVG(ratio) AS rate, COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM scan_rates
  GROUP BY status
),
overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(rate) AS avg_rate FROM status_stats
)
SELECT AVG(ss.rate) AS mean_rate,
       AVG(ss.cnt) AS mean_count,
       AVG(ss.rate - o.avg_rate) AS mean_diff
FROM status_stats ss, overall o
WHERE o.avg_rate IS NOT NULL AND ss.rate > o.avg_rate;
WITH per_status AS (
  SELECT s.healtheval AS status,
         AVG(CASE WHEN sc.gbsize IS NOT NULL AND sc.spanmin IS NOT NULL AND sc.spanmin <> 0
                  THEN sc.gbsize * 1.0 / sc.spanmin END) AS rate,
         COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM scans sc
  JOIN sites s ON sc.zoneref = s.zoneregistry
  GROUP BY s.healtheval
),
overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(rate) AS avg_rate FROM per_status
)
SELECT AVG(p.rate) AS mean_rate,
       AVG(p.cnt) AS mean_count,
       AVG(p.rate - o.avg_rate) AS mean_diff
FROM per_status p
CROSS JOIN overall o
WHERE o.avg_rate IS NOT NULL
  AND p.rate > o.avg_rate;
